class.name: OcgTopodsIterator
class.brief_description: Iterates on the underlying shape underlying a given TopoDS_Shape object, providing access to its component sub-shapes. Each component shape is returned as a TopoDS_Shape with an orientation, and a compound of the original values and the relative values.
class.description: ! Iterates on the underlying shape underlying a given ! TopoDS_Shape object, providing access to its ! component sub-shapes. Each component shape is ! returned as a TopoDS_Shape with an orientation, ! and a compound of the original values and the relative values.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates an Iterator on <S> sub-shapes. Note: - If cumOri is true, the function composes all sub-shapes with the orientation of S. - If cumLoc is true, the function multiplies all sub-shapes by the location of S, i.e. it applies to each sub-shape the transformation that is associated with S.

method.name: Initialize
method.description: Initializes this iterator with shape S. Note: - If cumOri is true, the function composes all sub-shapes with the orientation of S. - If cumLoc is true, the function multiplies all sub-shapes by the location of S, i.e. it applies to each sub-shape the transformation that is associated with S.

method.name: More
method.description: Returns true if there is another sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning.

method.name: Next
method.description: Moves on to the next sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning. Exceptions Standard_NoMoreObject if there are no more sub-shapes in the shape.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the current sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if there is no current sub-shape.
